integrity: The finite calculations are reproducible with Python standard library; the infinite-range conclusion relies on published shellability, not numerical extrapolation. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The three new finite cases m4,m5,m6 are verified exhaustively rather than by a uniform symbolic collapse. The seven-column type is a consequence of existing top homology, connectivity, Euler and wedge lemmas and is not claimed new. Other capacities and equivariant homotopy are not classified; unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Integral homotopy classification of four-row \((1,1,1,2)\) multiple chessboard complexes
